description: Return the derived AgentCapabilityCatalog: per-harness live capabilities (doctor-backed), canonical modes, the mutability matrix, run-control keys, CLI verbs, and the run-apply-state vocabulary.
name: claudexor_capabilities

outputSchema.description: Machine-readable capability catalog for external agents — derived, never hand-maintained.

availableHarnesses.description: Convenience: ids with doctor status ok.

cliCommands.description: CLI verbs with mutability/stability (full flag detail via `claudexor help --json`).

items.description: CLI verb projection from the command registry (same data `claudexor help --json` serves).

mutability.description: read = never mutates the tree; write = produces tree changes (envelope or live); delivery = moves an existing WorkProduct into the tree/VCS; ops = local config/daemon plumbing.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the catalog was composed.

git.description: Execution-location Git readiness. Read-only and valid non-Git in-place flows do not require it.

items.description: Per-harness live capability row (manifest + doctor + model truth).

accessControl.description: Negotiated access-control grants beyond the access profile. Engines that predate this row omit it (= no auxiliary writable roots).

auxiliaryWritableRoots.description: True when this harness applies execution.auxiliaryWritableRoots natively under workspace_write, and a later run whose effective execution carries no list (a new thread turn without one) keeps no earlier grant; false lanes refuse an explicit pool and drop from an auto pool.

accessProfilesSupported.description: Access profiles the adapter can enforce.

items.description: Active filesystem/command access profile for a run: readonly (no writes), workspace_write (use the harness's native workspace-write policy), full (unrestricted; requires the per-repo trust allow for a run an operator starts at a surface, not for an execution.delegated run), inherit_native (defer to the harness's own native settings).

attachmentInputs.description: Finite media/MIME/size/count/transport declarations for this adapter.

items.description: Finite MIME, size, count and transport limits declared by one adapter.

kind.description: Kind of attached resource: image input or generic file bytes.

transport.description: Native adapter transport used for one supported attachment class.

configuredModel.description: The user's configured per-harness default model, if any (null = engine default routing).

configuredModelValid.description: Admission of configuredModel under the harness's own absence declaration (INV-104): false = refused by an authoritative list, or no list could be read; true = listed, or unlisted on an advisory harness (forwarded to the vendor; the settings write and doctor readiness carry that note); null when no model is configured.

delegation.description: Whether this installed runtime can offer Delegate through this harness.

available.description: Whether this harness can receive the packaged delegation belt.

reason.description: Stable reason for the current delegation capability verdict.

remediation.description: Concrete update/repair guidance when unavailable; null when ready.

requiresFullAccess.description: Whether this harness can reach the belt only under a full-access profile.

disabledIntents.description: Intents the doctor disabled (with reasons in `reasons`).

displayName.description: Human display name from the manifest.

effortLevels.description: Reasoning-effort ladder the adapter declares (normalized by the engine).

items.description: Cross-harness reasoning-effort level as a lowercase slug (open vocabulary, mirroring the vendor contract); adapters advertise the levels they accept per model, ordered weakest to strongest by the vendor itself, and a shared normalizer passes advertised levels through, clamps inside the vendor order, places a word the vendor order lacks by the shared preference order (none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh < max < ultra) onto an advertised level, and refuses words neither order places.

enabled.description: False when settings disable this harness (harnesses.<id>.enabled=false) — routing excludes it regardless of doctor status.

enabledIntents.description: Intents the gateway will route to this harness right now.

id.description: Harness id (codex, claude, cursor, opencode, raw-api, openrouter, ...).

items.description: Adapter-owned observed input bound, not a predictive refusal or a model-window claim.

shape.description: Ordinary ASK initial attempt, including thread-turn continuity; excludes deep-scan and automatic continuation attempts.

scope.description: All text input items in one native turn; separate instructions are excluded.

verified_against.description: Native runtime version against which the bound was observed.

liveInput.description: How a live message enters one of this harness's RUNNING sessions (POST /v2/runs/:id/messages): mid_turn | next_tool_boundary | none. The harness maximum from its capability profile; the POST answers for the specific run. Omitted by engines older than 3.16.0 (= none).

models.description: Summary of a harness's model truth source (full list via the models endpoint/verb).

count.description: Number of enumerable models (GET /harnesses/:id/models has the full list).

source.description: Where the model list comes from: a live vendor API enumeration, the adapter manifest's curated hints, or nothing (model overrides are refused for source=none).

verifiedAgainst.description: Vendor CLI version the manifest hints were last verified against (null for api/none sources).

items.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

promptCacheTtls.description: Exact promptCacheTtl values this harness's adapter translates into native controls; empty when a requested value would be disclosed as ignored, omitted by engines without the run control.

items.description: Native prompt-cache lifetime for the main conversation and helper requests of a harness that declares it. Omission sends no override: native defaults, profile settings and the inherited environment stay in effect.

providerFamily.description: Vendor family the harness routes to.

readonlyMechanism.description: HOW read-only is enforced (fs_sandbox | permission_deny | tool_allowlist | none) — none means read-only intent is advisory for this harness.

reasons.description: Human-readable doctor/discovery reasons for degraded or unavailable status.

anyOf.description: Effective setup-login flow for this harness on the current host.

mode.description: in_app requests the daemon-hosted login flow; external_terminal requests the existing client PTY flow.

setupLogin.description: Effective setup-login flow for this harness on the current host; current producers emit null or an object, while omission identifies a legacy catalog row.

status.description: Doctor verdict: ok | degraded | unavailable (doctor-backed, cached ~90s).

webPolicy.description: How external web/search is controlled for this harness.

writeMechanism.description: HOW workspace_write is confined (fs_sandbox | tool_policy | none) — fs_sandbox is the base sandbox; a native automatic reviewer may still admit individual actions outside it. tool_policy means an allowed shell is unconfined (no FS/network fence); consumers choosing lanes by confinement read THIS field, never a harness name.

mcpTools.description: MCP tool names `claudexor mcp serve` exposes.

modes.description: Canonical run modes; strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

items.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

mutability.description: The mutability matrix: every way a Claudexor run can (or cannot) touch a tree, from the schema's closed vocabularies.

accessProfiles.description: Access vocabulary; `full` additionally requires the per-repo trust allow (claudexor trust --allow-full-access) for a run an operator starts at a surface, not for an execution.delegated run.

items.description: Active filesystem/command access profile for a run: readonly (no writes), workspace_write (use the harness's native workspace-write policy), full (unrestricted; requires the per-repo trust allow for a run an operator starts at a surface, not for an execution.delegated run), inherit_native (defer to the harness's own native settings).

applyModes.description: Delivery modes for applying a run's WorkProduct to the project.

isolationKinds.description: Run isolation: envelope = isolated worktree in the external per-project runtime namespace (default), live = the project tree itself.

readOnlyModes.description: Canonical modes that never mutate the project tree (ask/plan).

items.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

Per-thread workspace mode: in_place mutates the live project tree directly (the default); isolated keeps a persistent git worktree per thread that apply merges into the project; delegated runs every turn in one caller-owned workspace bound at creation, which Claudexor never applies to the project or deletes.

writeModes.description: Canonical modes that may mutate a tree (agent).

items.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

ok.description: Envelope marker (matches the CLI JSON convention).

outputSchemaDialects.description: Supported structured-output JSON Schema dialects and canonical $schema URIs.

items.description: One JSON Schema dialect accepted by the structured-output validator.

defaultWhenOmitted.description: True when this dialect is selected for schemas without a $schema declaration.

dialect.description: Stable dialect id used in structured-output receipts.

uri.description: Canonical $schema URI accepted for this dialect.

runApplyStates.description: RunApplyState vocabulary an agent can encounter on run results (not_applied | applied | applied_review_blocked | reverted) — distinct from the ApplyEligibility verdict object on run details.

runControlKeys.description: Accepted POST /runs request keys (derived from the ControlRunStartRequest schema; the CLI/MCP/ACP surfaces project subsets of these).

version.description: Claudexor version serving this catalog (compare with CLAUDEXOR_PLUGIN_VERSION to detect plugin skew).
